assessment.market_summary: The Cape of Good Hope is experiencing increased traffic and operational strain due to Suez/Bab el-Mandeb diversions, with significant port delays in Cape Town. While global powers are coordinating to secure alternative routes, South Africa's infrastructure limitations are creating bottlenecks and missed economic opportunities. Traders should factor in extended transit times and potential congestion-related surcharges
assessment.score_rationale: Elevated tension from Suez diversions driving heavy traffic, compounded by port congestion and infrastructure constraints, though no active conflict or security incidents reported.
